# CNN

> > CNN is a leading global news organization providing breaking news, live updates, and in-depth coverage across politics, business, world events, health, science, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle.

CNN delivers comprehensive news coverage across multiple verticals including politics, business, international affairs, health, science, and entertainment. The site emphasizes breaking news, live video content, and real-time updates on major global events including conflict coverage, elections, and trending stories.

## Key Topics

- live-updates

- politics

## News Hubs

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos](https://www.cnn.com): CNN homepage with breaking news, live updates, and trending stories across all topics
- [US News](https://www.cnn.com/us): US news hub covering national news, politics, government, and homeland security
- [World News](https://www.cnn.com/world): International news coverage from Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East, and Americas
- [Politics](https://www.cnn.com/politics): Politics news with election coverage, fact-checks, and Trump administration updates
- [Business](https://www.cnn.com/business): Business news covering markets, stocks, tech, M&A, and economic trends

## Major Conflict Coverage

- [Russian Invasion of Ukraine](https://www.cnn.com/world/europe/ukraine): Russia-Ukraine war coverage with latest news, analysis, and conflict updates
- [Israel-Hamas War](https://www.cnn.com/world/middleeast/israel): Israel-Hamas war coverage with Middle East conflict analysis and breaking news

## Health, Science & Environment

- [Health](https://www.cnn.com/health): Health news on fitness, nutrition, medicine, mental health, and wellness
- [Science](https://www.cnn.com/science): Science news on NASA missions, space exploration, and research developments
- [Climate](https://www.cnn.com/climate): Climate change, global warming, clean energy, and environmental policy coverage
- [Weather](https://www.cnn.com/weather): Weather forecasts, severe storm coverage, and hurricane tracking across US

## Entertainment & Lifestyle

- [Entertainment](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment): Entertainment coverage of movies, music, TV, Oscars, and celebrity news
- [Sports](https://www.cnn.com/sports): Sports news covering football, soccer, tennis, golf, and major sporting events
- [Style](https://www.cnn.com/style): Fashion, beauty, luxury, and design coverage with celebrity style highlights
- [Travel](https://www.cnn.com/travel): Travel guides, destination reviews, and insider tips for global travel

## Audio & Multimedia

- [CNN Podcasts](https://www.cnn.com/audio): CNN podcasts, news briefs, and audio content including Spanish-language shows

## Optional

- [CNN Games](https://www.cnn.com/games): Free games and puzzles including crosswords, sudoku, and daily brain teasers
